definition: to put seeds or young plants into the ground
description: A small girl in a pale dress spins on the spot in a beamed living room, her skirt flying out, while a white-haired woman in an armchair claps and laughs. The two sit at a low table with a flowered tea set as an elderly man sips from a small cup. In close-up, the girl's hands lower a young flowering plant, roots and soil together, into a hole dug in dark earth while a man's hand steadies it and a trowel lies beside the hole. The camera pulls back to a sunny garden bed where grandparents and several children kneel in a row, setting plants into the soil and watering them.

taps.phrase: to clap her hands with delight
